home.title: Munaxa Work
home.lead: Enterprise HR administration. Every screen below reads the product API and shows what it returned.

record.title: Employee record
record.boundaries: What this record does not show
record.notFound: No employment with this identifier was returned.
record.nothingReadable: Nothing on this record could be read.

notice.readOnly: This portal reads; it writes nothing. Every change is an API capability the server decides.
notice.sectionWithheld: This section was withheld: the API did not answer for this caller.
notice.eachSectionIsItsOwnPermission: Each section is a separate request under its own permission, so a section may be withheld while its neighbours are not.
notice.identifiersNotNames: Where a name belongs to another module and was not returned, a shortened identifier is shown rather than a name this screen invented.
notice.noDocumentContent: Document content is not stored by this product: there is no storage adapter, so nothing here can be opened or downloaded.
notice.notSignedIn: No principal is authenticated: this deployment has no Platform authentication adapter, so every read fails closed and every section is empty.
notice.noOffboarding: Offboarding, final settlement, loans and benefits are not built.
notice.noSelfService: This record is the administrator's view. Employee and manager self-service are not built.
notice.noPerformanceRead: Performance publishes no per-employment review read: the module holds that confirming a review exists for a named employment is itself a disclosure, so this record does not ask for one.
notice.noCompensationOnRecord: Salary and compensation are not on this record. Compensation publishes per-employment reads and putting them on the record everybody opens is a decision nobody has taken.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: What is waiting on you, and what you have already answered.
approvals.nothingDecided: You have not decided anything yet.
approvals.notFound: No approval with this identifier was returned.
approvals.boundaries: What this screen does not do
approvals.decidingIsApi: Approving and rejecting are API capabilities the server decides. This screen reads; it offers no decision control, because a request from this portal carries no authenticated principal.
approvals.subjectIsOpaque: A subject is a type and an identifier. Workflow never interprets what a requisition is, and neither does this screen; describing one in business terms means asking the module that owns it.
approvals.membershipsAreIdentifiers: A membership is shown in full and never as a name: no module publishes a lookup from a membership to a person.
approvals.onlyRecruitmentRaises: Recruitment is the only module that currently raises approvals. Leave, payroll, compensation and attendance publish their own approval records and do not yet route through this engine.
approvals.nothingExpires: Nothing expires, escalates or is reminded on its own. Every figure here was counted by the server; none is computed on this screen.
approvals.portVocabulary: The same approval as a requesting module sees it, in the approval port’s own five-state vocabulary.

access.signInUnconfigured: This deployment has no Munaxa Platform sign-in configured yet, so there is nowhere to sign in. An administrator sets PLATFORM_SIGN_IN_URL once Platform's authentication service is available.

ok.title: Nothing to show
ok.detail: This view has no records yet.

signedOut.title: You are not signed in
signedOut.detail: Munaxa Platform authenticates you, and Munaxa Work reads what it vouches for. Sign in to continue.

noMembership.title: No workspace for this account
noMembership.detail: You are signed in, but this account is not an active member of a Munaxa Work tenant. Signing in again will not change that — an administrator has to admit the account.

withheld.title: Withheld
withheld.detail: You are a member of this workspace, but you do not hold the permission this view requires. Permissions are granted in Munaxa Platform.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.detail: There is no such record, or it belongs to another workspace.

unavailable.title: Munaxa Work is unavailable
unavailable.detail: The service did not answer. This is not a problem with your account or your permissions.
